runnerPolicy.architectureAdmission: Assert runner.os/arch and capture image version; reject mismatch. No latest aliases.

releaseTrust.signature: Ed25519 detached signature over exact UTF-8 manifest bytes; external release signer, pinned distributor public key.
releaseTrust.keyBootstrap: Public distributor key ships through the reviewed source/release channel; never trust a replacement key from an asset or input project.
releaseTrust.missingSignature: Reject release installation; unsigned local test assets must remain visibly development-only.
releaseTrust.credentialStatus: No signing credentials provisioned or inspected by this baseline; release remains blocked until external operator supplies trusted signing.

unsupportedMeaning: Not desktop release targets; no retained professional JAI catalogue or workflow is removed.
